guides.title: 師傅導讀：橋梁尚未合龍時，力走哪裡？
guides.titleEn: Mentor guide: Where do loads go before bridge closure?
guides.concept: 斜張橋在施工中不斷改變支承條件。完成節塊吊裝並不等於完成結構接合；合龍後的連續橋面，也不能直接代表吊裝中的懸臂。先分階段畫自由體圖，再討論索力與橋面高程，才能把「拼起來」變成可檢查的工程推理。
guides.conceptEn: A cable-stayed bridge changes its support conditions during erection. Placing a closure segment does not complete its structural connections. Treat the unclosed cantilever and the connected deck as different systems before discussing stay forces or deck elevation.
procedure: 依官方施工敘述，自繪「吊入節塊、暫時連接、斜索調整、完成接合」四張示意圖；缺乏施工細節處標為待查。
在每張圖上標示自重、索力、支承與施工設備荷重，用箭頭連到基礎；不得把尚未接合的接縫畫成剛接。
以同一張示意圖比較增加一個節塊前後，哪些索、塔與橋面區段會改變受力；只推論方向，不替工程猜測數值。
把官方的索力施拉、銲接與線形校正記錄連到對應階段，寫出解除臨時支承前必須取得哪些設計與量測確認。
procedureEn: Draw four original sketches: segment placement, temporary connection, stay adjustment and completed joining. Mark undocumented details as unknown.
Label dead load, stay forces, supports and construction-equipment loads. Trace them to the foundation; do not represent an unfinished joint as rigid.
Compare conditions before and after adding one segment. Predict which stays, pylon regions and deck sections change load, without inventing project values.
Associate the owner’s tensioning, welding and alignment records with stages. List the design and measurement approvals required before releasing temporary support.
evidence: 四張支承狀態不同且標註清楚的自由體示意。
一張「工序—受力改變—需查證資料」對照表。
解釋為何節塊就位照片不足以證明全橋已完成結構接合。
evidenceEn: Four annotated sketches with distinct support states.
A table linking each operation to a load-path change and required evidence.
An explanation of why a placement photograph alone cannot prove structural completion.
pitfalls: 把施工階段當成已完工橋梁計算。
只核對索力，忽略橋面高程、溫度與施工荷重。
把公開里程碑當成完整的現場作業指示。
pitfallsEn: Analysing an erection stage as a finished bridge.
Checking stay force while ignoring deck elevation, temperature and construction loads.
Treating a public milestone report as a complete field procedure.

guides.title: 師傅導讀：從線形誤差到可追溯的橋梁健康紀錄
guides.titleEn: Mentor guide: From alignment error to traceable bridge-health records
guides.concept: 索力或高程變化可能來自施工調整、溫度、車流、感測器偏移或結構狀態改變。同一數字在不同時刻未必可直接比較。監測的核心是保留基準、單位、環境與儀器狀態，並用獨立證據辨別異常。
guides.conceptEn: A change in stay force or elevation can reflect adjustments, temperature, traffic, sensor drift or structural behaviour. Monitoring requires comparable baselines and independent checks, rather than treating every change as damage.
procedure: 依官方耐久與監測說明，建立「斜索、錨定端、橋面、橋塔」觀測清單；每列對應可見缺陷或可量測物理量。
自行製作學習用紀錄表，保留時間、構件編號、儀器、校正資訊、單位、溫度與作業狀態；沒有實測值就保留空白。
假設某索力讀值突然改變，分別提出儀器、環境、構件三種解釋，為每一種指定一項能區分原因的後續證據。
把視覺檢查、索力量測與幾何複測安排在同一時間軸；寫出應由誰核定判讀與下一步，並保留原始資料。
procedureEn: Build an observation list for stays, anchorages, deck and pylon using the official durability and monitoring description. Associate each with a visible condition or measurable quantity.
Create a learning record with time, component ID, instrument, calibration information, units, temperature and work state. Leave unavailable measurements blank.
For a hypothetical sudden stay-force change, propose instrument, environmental and structural explanations. Specify one discriminating observation for each.
Align visual inspections, force measurements and geometry surveys on a timeline. Identify who must approve interpretation and follow-up while preserving raw records.
evidence: 含資料來源及缺值標記的監測表。
三個競爭假說及各自的查證方法。
可從結論回查到構件、時間與原始紀錄的證據鏈。
evidenceEn: A monitoring sheet that identifies provenance and missing values.
Three competing hypotheses with discriminating checks.
A traceable chain from conclusion to component, time and original record.
pitfalls: 將單一感測器警報直接等同結構破壞。
拿不同溫度或荷重狀態的讀值硬作比較。
自行捏造警戒門檻或把設計壽命當作免維護年限。
pitfallsEn: Equating one sensor alarm with structural failure.
Comparing readings taken under different temperatures or loads without adjustment.
Inventing alarm limits or interpreting design life as maintenance-free life.

guides.title: 師傅導讀：硬岩為何仍會困住鑽掘機？
guides.titleEn: Mentor guide: Why can hard rock still trap a TBM?
guides.concept: 岩塊很硬，不代表整體岩盤穩定。裂隙方向、破碎帶、地下水壓與開挖擾動會共同改變掌子面及機身周圍條件。雪山隧道的公開案例適合練習把「材料強度」和「岩體行為」分開判讀。
guides.conceptEn: Hard intact rock does not guarantee a stable rock mass. Discontinuities, fractured zones, groundwater and excavation disturbance influence the face and the ground around the machine. Use the Hsuehshan case to separate material strength from rock-mass behaviour.
procedure: 由官方歷史文獻整理兩欄：已知地層與施工中實際遭遇；把觀察到的湧水、破碎與夾埋分開記錄。
自繪沿線地質示意，標示已查到的破碎帶與地下水可能路徑；未取得精確位置時不自行補數。
建立「現象—可能機制—需要資料」表，例如湧水增加需比對壓力、流量與出水位置，推進阻力改變需比對機況與地層。
對同一假想異常提出至少兩個假說，指定超前調查或現場監測應補足的資訊，再寫出何時應暫停推進並交由工程團隊審查。
procedureEn: Separate the official historical record into anticipated geology and encountered conditions. Record inflow, fragmentation and machine entrapment independently.
Draw an original geological section showing documented fractured zones and plausible water paths. Do not fabricate exact locations.
Create an observation–mechanism–evidence table: an inflow change requires pressure, flow and location information; changed resistance requires both machine and ground evidence.
For one hypothetical anomaly, give two hypotheses and the investigation or monitoring needed to distinguish them. Define the information gap that warrants a stop and engineering review.
evidence: 岩塊性質與岩體結構分列的概念圖。
含至少兩種可能原因的異常判讀表。
說明採用機械鑽掘或其他工法不能僅由岩石硬度決定。
evidenceEn: A concept map separating intact-rock properties from rock-mass structure.
An anomaly table with at least two plausible causes.
An explanation of why hardness alone cannot choose the excavation method.
pitfalls: 把岩塊抗壓強度直接當成掌子面穩定保證。
把有水與有高水壓視為同一觀測。
把歷史個案的處置搬成任何隧道通用配方。
pitfallsEn: Using intact-rock strength as proof of face stability.
Confusing the presence of water with evidence of high water pressure.
Turning one historical response into a universal tunnelling recipe.

guides.title: 師傅導讀：把通風系統畫成可驗證的控制迴路
guides.titleEn: Mentor guide: Draw ventilation as a verifiable control loop
guides.concept: 風機是致動器，空氣品質與風向風速是回饋，交控與供電則限制可採取的動作。平時稀釋污染物和火災時控制煙流的目標不同，不能把「全部開到最大」當作共同答案。
guides.conceptEn: Fans are actuators; air quality and airflow measurements provide feedback. Traffic control and power availability constrain the response. Routine pollutant dilution and fire-smoke management are different control objectives.
procedure: 觀看官方長版影片，畫出洞外、進氣豎井、車道、排氣豎井四部分，另標出軸流與噴流風機。
在圖旁補上空氣品質、能見度、風向風速及設備狀態等輸入；以箭頭連到控制判斷與致動設備。
建立正常交通、壅塞、火警、停電四列情境表；每列說明控制目標與需要確認的資料，實際設定留給核定文件。
用紙上故障案例測試：若回傳資料中斷或風機有命令卻無狀態確認，哪些量測能判斷是感測、通訊、供電或設備問題？
procedureEn: Watch the official long film and draw outside air, intake shaft, roadway and exhaust shaft. Identify axial and jet fans separately.
Add air-quality, visibility, airflow and equipment-state inputs. Connect these to decisions and actuators.
Create scenarios for normal traffic, congestion, fire and power loss. State the objective and required evidence for each; leave actual settings to approved documentation.
Run a paper fault case: if telemetry disappears or a commanded fan lacks confirmation, what observations distinguish sensing, communication, power and equipment faults?
evidence: 可追蹤輸入、決策、輸出與回饋的控制圖。
四種情境各有不同控制目標的比較表。
一份把命令、回報狀態與實際風流分開驗證的故障追查紀錄。
evidenceEn: A diagram tracing input, decision, output and feedback.
A comparison of control objectives across four operating scenarios.
A fault record checking command, reported state and actual airflow separately.
pitfalls: 把風機運轉回報當成已量到所需風量。
忽略火災位置與煙流分層，套用日常通風邏輯。
將歷史文獻數值當成目前核定的緊急操作設定。
pitfallsEn: Treating a running-status signal as a measurement of adequate airflow.
Applying normal ventilation logic without considering fire location or smoke stratification.
Treating historical document values as current approved emergency settings.

guides.title: 師傅導讀：從水頭到電力，別漏掉能量損失
guides.titleEn: Mentor guide: From hydraulic head to electricity, account for losses
guides.concept: 水力發電把水的能量經水輪機轉成軸功，再由發電機轉成電能。可用功率與淨水頭、流量和總效率有關；壩高不是自動等於淨水頭，裝置容量也不是所有時間的實際輸出。
guides.conceptEn: Hydropower converts hydraulic energy to shaft work and then electricity. Output depends on net head, flow and combined efficiency. Dam height is not automatically net head, and installed capacity is not continuous output.
procedure: 觀看電站原理影片，自繪水流與能量兩條路徑，標出進水、壓力水道、水輪機、發電機與尾水。
寫出學習模型 P = ρgQHη，逐一標示密度、重力加速度、流量、淨水頭與總效率的單位。
自行選一組標為「虛構練習」的 Q、H、η，比較流量或水頭改變時功率的趨勢；不得把結果標成三峽實測。
把水道損失、機械損失、電氣損失列成三欄，指出各自需取得的量測；缺乏效率曲線時保留不確定性。
procedureEn: Draw separate water and energy paths after watching the plant film. Identify intake, pressure conduit, turbine, generator and tailwater.
Write the learning model P = ρgQHη and label the units of density, gravity, flow, net head and overall efficiency.
Choose explicitly fictional Q, H and η values. Compare the output trend as flow or head changes; never label the result as measured Three Gorges performance.
Separate hydraulic, mechanical and electrical losses. Specify the measurements needed for each and retain uncertainty when efficiency curves are unavailable.
evidence: 水流路徑與能量轉換圖。
單位一致、假設清楚的功率估算表。
解釋毛水頭、淨水頭、額定容量與實際輸出的差異。
evidenceEn: Water-path and energy-conversion diagrams.
A dimensionally consistent power estimate with explicit assumptions.
A distinction between gross head, net head, rated capacity and actual output.
pitfalls: 用壩頂至河床高度代替工作淨水頭。
把效率設為百分之百卻未標成理想模型。
只追求流量，忽略水輪機允許運轉範圍。
pitfallsEn: Substituting dam height for operating net head.
Using 100% efficiency without identifying an ideal model.
Increasing flow without considering the turbine operating envelope.

guides.title: 師傅導讀：水庫削峰不是把洪水消失掉
guides.titleEn: Mentor guide: Flood attenuation stores water; it does not erase it
guides.concept: 水庫調度改變洪水通過的時間與流量，但水量仍須守恆。入流大於出流會增加蓄水；已被占用的庫容會限制後續洪峰的緩衝空間。下游支流洪峰與預報誤差也必須納入判斷。
guides.conceptEn: Reservoir operation changes the timing and magnitude of a flood hydrograph while conserving water. Inflow above outflow increases storage and uses space needed for later inflows. Downstream tributary peaks and forecast uncertainty also matter.
procedure: 由官方調度案例分列攔洪、削峰與錯峰三種目的，不將任何一個案例的流量直接套用到別的事件。
自製虛構入流與出流時序表，統一時間步長與單位，用 ΔS = (Qin − Qout)Δt 逐步更新蓄水量。
為模型設定明確標示為教學假設的庫容上限，比較提前釋放、延後釋放對剩餘空間與下游流量的影響。
再加入「支流較早洪峰」或「入流預報偏低」情境，記錄原方案何時失效及需要更新的資訊。
procedureEn: Separate retention, peak reduction and peak-timing objectives in official dispatch cases. Do not transfer event-specific releases to another flood.
Create fictional inflow and outflow time series with consistent units and time steps. Update storage using ΔS = (Qin − Qout)Δt.
Set an explicitly educational storage limit. Compare early and delayed releases in terms of remaining storage and downstream flow.
Add an earlier tributary peak or an underestimated inflow forecast. Identify when the original plan fails and what information must be updated.
evidence: 逐時段水量平衡表，累計誤差可回查。
兩種釋放方案的蓄水與下游流量比較。
標示預報不確定性及生態、航運、供水需求的決策註記。
evidenceEn: A time-step water balance with traceable cumulative error.
A comparison of storage and downstream flow under two release scenarios.
Decision notes covering forecast uncertainty, ecology, navigation and water supply.
pitfalls: 把瞬間流量與累計水量直接相比。
只算壩址出流，忽略下游區間來水。
將課堂模型的「最佳解」稱為實際調度命令。
pitfallsEn: Comparing instantaneous flow directly with accumulated volume.
Considering only dam releases while ignoring downstream inflows.
Presenting a classroom optimum as an operational dispatch order.

區分縮短候車時間的營運目標與維持安全間隔的必要條件。

guides.title: 師傅導讀：移動閉塞仍然需要停得下來的證據
guides.titleEn: Mentor guide: Moving block still requires evidence of stopping capability
guides.concept: 更頻繁取得位置資訊，有助於細緻管理列車間隔，但無法消除煞車距離。通訊延遲、位置不確定度、坡度與黏著條件都會影響保護範圍。用簡化模型理解依存關係，不能據此設定真實號誌參數。
guides.conceptEn: More frequent position information supports finer separation management but does not remove braking distance. Latency, position uncertainty, gradient and adhesion affect the protective envelope. A simple model explains dependencies, not operational signalling settings.
procedure: 以官方 CBTC 影片畫出列車、軌旁與控制中心的資訊交換，標出位置、速度與移動授權的不同角色。
在紙上建立兩列車位置圖，分別畫出前車占用範圍、後車位置誤差與後車可用停止距離。
使用理想化 d = v²/(2a) 比較同一減速度下速度加倍的影響；另以 vτ 表示示意延遲距離，所有數值明列為教學假設。
討論一筆位置回報過期時，哪些條件不能再確定；把保守限制與重新取得可信位置證據寫成狀態轉換。
procedureEn: Map train, wayside and control-centre communication from the official CBTC film. Distinguish position, speed and movement authority.
Draw two trains with the leading train’s occupied extent, following-train position uncertainty and available stopping distance.
Use idealised d = v²/(2a) to compare doubled speed at constant deceleration; add illustrative latency travel vτ. Label all numerical inputs as teaching assumptions.
Identify what becomes unknown when a position report is stale. Describe conservative restrictions and the evidence needed to restore a trusted position state.
evidence: 不重疊的占用與保護範圍示意。
呈現速度平方關係的紙上計算。
說明位置更新率改善不能取代煞車能力與安全驗證。
evidenceEn: A sketch distinguishing occupied and protected extents.
A calculation demonstrating the square-of-speed relationship.
An explanation of why update rate cannot replace braking capability or safety validation.
pitfalls: 把發出煞車命令當成列車已經停止。
把通訊中斷等同軌道上沒有列車。
把簡化等減速模型當成核准的安全煞車曲線。
pitfallsEn: Treating a brake command as proof the train has stopped.
Treating lost communication as an unoccupied track.
Using a constant-deceleration exercise as an approved safe braking curve.

guides.title: 師傅導讀：列車能動，不代表整套捷運已驗證
guides.titleEn: Mentor guide: A moving train does not prove an integrated metro
guides.concept: 車輛、號誌、月台與電力之間的介面，往往決定系統是否能安全而穩定地營運。單機功能合格不等於整合情境合格。LTA 的號誌模擬設施提供一個公開例子：在受控環境先測軟體與營運場景。
guides.conceptEn: Interfaces among rolling stock, signalling, platforms and traction power determine system behaviour. Passing a component test does not establish integrated performance. LTA’s simulation facilities illustrate testing software changes against operational scenarios before mainline use.
procedure: 為「列車到站、停妥、開門、關門、允許發車」自繪狀態表，列出每次轉換必需的確認資訊。
依 LTA 公開情境，加入臨時速限、列車留站及班距調整；記錄其對車輛命令與號誌授權的不同影響。
每個情境建立預期結果、觀察量與失敗條件；再加入一個介面回報延遲，檢查系統是否仍有清楚的限制狀態。
把軟體版本、設定、模擬器版本與測試紀錄綁成同一組，說明重測與正式線路驗證還缺哪些證據。
procedureEn: Draw a state table for arrival, verified stop, door opening, door closure and departure permission. List the confirmations required at each transition.
Add the published LTA scenarios: temporary speed restriction, holding at a platform and headway regulation. Separate their effects on commands and authority.
Define expected results, observable signals and failure conditions. Introduce delayed interface feedback and check for a clearly restricted state.
Bind software version, configuration, simulator version and test records together. List the evidence still needed for regression and mainline validation.
evidence: 狀態轉換與允許條件矩陣。
至少三個營運情境與一個介面異常的測試表。
能由結果回溯軟體與設定版本的測試紀錄。
evidenceEn: A state-transition and permission matrix.
A test sheet with three operational scenarios and one interface anomaly.
Test records traceable to software and configuration versions.
pitfalls: 只驗證正常旅程而忽略異常回報。
把模擬成功直接宣稱可載客營運。
測試時更動設定，卻沒有留下版本紀錄。
pitfallsEn: Testing only a normal journey and ignoring abnormal feedback.
Declaring readiness for passenger service from simulation alone.
Changing configuration during testing without preserving version history.

guides.title: 師傅導讀：分清煙氣、鍋爐水與做功蒸汽
guides.titleEn: Mentor guide: Separate combustion gas, boiler water and working steam
guides.concept: 蒸汽機車看似一個大型鍋爐，實際上至少有三條不同流路。煙氣把熱傳給水，產生的蒸汽進入汽缸做功，再經排汽系統離開。輪子轉動來自壓力差與連桿機構，而不是煙直接推動車輪。
guides.conceptEn: A steam locomotive contains distinct gas, water and steam paths. Combustion gases transfer heat to water; steam then expands in cylinders and exhausts. Pressure differences and mechanical linkages turn the wheels, rather than smoke driving them directly.
procedure: 觀看 NPS 蒸汽原理解說，以三種線型自繪煙氣、給水與蒸汽流路，交會處僅代表換熱時不得畫成流體混合。
把熱量傳入、汽缸做功與機械傳動分成三段，為每段列出輸入與輸出。
在不加壓的紙上模型中，畫出活塞前後兩端壓力不同時的受力方向；再連到連桿與曲柄。
依博物館剖面解說，指出圖上看不到或尚未查證的部件，將它們列為待查而不是補造配置。
procedureEn: Watch the NPS explanation and draw gas, feedwater and steam routes with different line styles. Do not show fluid mixing where only heat transfer occurs.
Separate heat input, cylinder work and mechanical transmission. List the input and output of each.
In an unpressurised paper model, draw the force direction caused by different pressures across a piston and connect it to the rod and crank.
Use the museum cutaway explanation to identify missing or unverified components. Mark them for research instead of inventing an arrangement.
evidence: 三條不混淆的流路示意。
能量轉換與損失位置的標註。
能用自己的話說明鍋爐、汽缸與連桿各自的作用。
evidenceEn: A schematic with three distinct fluid paths.
Annotations locating energy conversions and losses.
An independent explanation of the boiler, cylinder and connecting-rod roles.
pitfalls: 把火管內煙氣與管外水混成一條路徑。
把高壓當成無限能量來源而忽略熱輸入。
將博物館原理介紹當成壓力容器製造或點火程序。
pitfallsEn: Merging gases inside fire tubes with water outside them.
Treating pressure as unlimited energy without heat input.
Using museum interpretation as pressure-vessel fabrication or firing instructions.

guides.title: 師傅導讀：從駕駛室儀表建立機械狀態判讀
guides.titleEn: Mentor guide: Read mechanical state through cab instruments
guides.concept: 儀表顯示的量、閥件改變的量與機器真正的反應不一定相同。駕駛室導覽可以用來練習「控制—量測—回應」對照；Big Boy 4012 的靜態展示也提醒我們，外觀完整不等於已具備動態運轉資格。
guides.conceptEn: An indicated quantity, a valve’s commanded change and the machine’s response are different kinds of evidence. Use the cab tour to map control, measurement and response. Big Boy 4012’s static display also distinguishes appearance from operational readiness.
procedure: 觀看 NPS 駕駛室導覽，把確認名稱的儀表與控制件列成表；聽不清楚的項目保留待查。
每列寫下它量測或控制的物理量、操作者希望知道的狀態，以及還需要哪些獨立觀察。
設計一個純紙上案例：指示值不動，但其他相關跡象改變；提出儀表失靈與系統狀態不變兩個假說，避免先指定原因。
比較 NPS 對靜態展示與完成運轉整修機車的說明，整理外觀修復、功能檢查與運轉驗證屬於不同證據層級。
procedureEn: Watch the NPS cab tour and tabulate instruments and controls whose names you can verify. Leave uncertain items unresolved.
For each, state the physical quantity, the condition the crew needs to infer and any independent observation required.
Create a paper case where one indication stays fixed while related signs change. Compare a faulty instrument with an unchanged process as competing hypotheses.
Compare NPS descriptions of static display and operational overhaul. Separate cosmetic restoration, functional checks and operating validation as distinct evidence levels.
evidence: 含已確認與待查項目的儀表功能表。
一項指示異常的兩個假說及區分方法。
說明為何看見閥件或輪子就不能判定機車可投入運轉。
evidenceEn: An instrument-function table separating verified and unresolved items.
Two hypotheses and discriminating evidence for an anomalous indication.
An explanation of why visible controls or wheels do not establish operating readiness.
pitfalls: 認為所有機車的閥件配置與操作邏輯相同。
把儀表讀值直接視為完整機械狀態。
忽略靜態展車與動態運轉機車的不同驗證要求。
pitfallsEn: Assuming all locomotives share the same valve arrangement and operating logic.
Treating one indication as the full mechanical state.
Ignoring the different evidence required for static display and operation.
